units.source_text: 太吉郎的铺子像正面的格子门那样，还保留着京都批发商的风格，

en.t: Taikichiro's shop, like the lattice door at the front, still retained the style of a Kyoto wholesaler,

units.source_text: 可是现在已经改成了公司，原先的代理人和店员都成了职员，

en.t: but by now it had been reorganized as a company, and the former agents and shop clerks had all become employees,

units.source_text: 大部分人改成每天从家里来上班，

en.t: most of them now came to work from their own homes every day,

units.source_text: 只有从近江来的两三个店员住在镶着小格子窗的二楼上。

en.t: and only two or three clerks from Omi lived upstairs on the second floor with its small lattice windows.
At dinnertime, the back of the shop was very quiet.
